thread:
dev-bot: Deploy started: rollout v3.2.1 -> prod (50% traffic to v3.2.1, 50% to v3.2.0). changelist: auth-hardening flag toggle. release notes: https://releases/internal/3.2.1

maria: noticing p99 latency spike on /embed route in eu-west within first 10m. p50 fine, p99 up ~120ms -> 450ms. api 401s also increased slightly.

sam: can you paste the slo dashboard snapshot? :eyes:

maria: screenshot attached in thread (uploaded). quick PromQL I'm running:
```
quantile(0.99, latency_seconds{route="/embed",region="eu-west"})
```
and
```
sum(increase(http_requests_total{code="401",route="/embed"}[5m])) by (region)
```

lia: hmm we toggled auth-harden flag in the same changelist. @sam any correlation with the auth service deploy? 

sam: auth team pushed a small hotfix 2m before this rollout. pinged them, waiting reply. :satellite:

ops-bot: Observability alert: eu-west /embed p99 > 400ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets. Trigger: slo/embeds-p99-eu. 

maria: +1 on alerts. Root logs show increased token validation retries in the service: `AuthError: token fetch failed 503` repeated. looks like retries amplify latency. 

sam: propose: PAUSE rollout at 50% and pin traffic for eu-west to v3.2.0 until auth is stable. Do not rollback globally yet. 

lia: agree. we should also mark this in release notes and set a rollback plan if p95 breaches 500ms for >5m. 

maria: I'll patch a temporary retry-budget in v3.2.1 config to reduce attempts from 5 -> 2, but that needs a rebuild and quick canary. if auth team fixes quickly we can resume. 

ops-bot: Action: set rollout state -> PAUSED. Traffic routing: EU region pinned to v3.2.0 using route rule `region=euw -> v3.2.0`. 

dev-bot: Command executed by @sam: `/deploy pause 6587654321` -> success. 

lia: Sam can you update the change-window doc with this TL;DR and who owns the triage? I'll add a line to release notes that EU customers may be on previous version temporarily. 

sam: taking triage ownership. I've created ticket INF-9823 and assigned to auth + embedders with a high priority. Link: https://kanban.internal/INF-9823 

maria: will test the reduced-retry config in a sandbox and report back in 10m. 

lia: good. if we end up rolling back, let's coordinate a quick rollback window and let CS know. 

sam: quick checklist: 1) paused rollout (done), 2) pin EU region (done), 3) triage ticket (done), 4) update release notes (lia), 5) follow-up postmortem if needed (owner: sam). 

maria: update: sandbox with retry=2 shows p99 back to ~180ms, 401 count down. tagging auth team again. 

auth-team-bot: confirmed root cause: upstream token endpoint degraded, rolling fix now. 

sam: thanks. if auth fix lands and canary in sandbox holds for 10m, we can resume traffic shift. will watch SLOs. 

lia: adding a note in the change-window: resumed only after 10m stable p99 < 250ms and 5m 401 rate back to baseline. 

maria: ack. will post final status here. :white_check_mark:
